stories.title: Asia Stocks Rise as Traders Pare Fed Hike Bets Ahead of US Jobs Data
stories.summary: Asian equity markets rose, led by technology shares, as investors scaled back bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike. The advance comes as markets wait for the latest U.S. jobs report, a key input for the Fed's next move.
stories.whyItMatters: Shifts in Fed rate expectations move global risk assets, and the jobs report could confirm or reverse the current rally.
whatToWatch: Release of the U.S. jobs report
Whether the tech-led gains carry into U.S. trading
Any Fed commentary responding to the data
questions: Will the jobs report support or undercut reduced hike expectations?

sources.title: Asia stocks rise as reduced Fed hike bets lift tech; U.S. jobs data awaited

stories.title: Asian Shares Climb as Fed's Waller Calms Bonds Ahead of Jobs Report
stories.summary: Asian shares climbed after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller made remarks that eased jitters in bond markets. Investors are also positioning ahead of the upcoming U.S. jobs data, a key driver of Fed rate expectations.
stories.whyItMatters: Comments from Fed officials move bond yields and equities directly, and the jobs report is the next major catalyst for rate-path bets.
whatToWatch: U.S. jobs report release
Bond yield moves following Waller's comments
Reaction from other Fed officials
questions: What specifically did Waller say to calm bond markets?
Will the calm hold once jobs data lands?

stories.title: Kalshi Bettors Push September Fed Rate-Hike Odds to 60%-68%
stories.summary: Prediction-market platform Kalshi shows bettors sharply raising the odds of a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in September, to a range of 60%-68%, according to Yahoo Finance. That marks a notable pullback in odds that had favored a rate cut.
stories.whyItMatters: Prediction-market pricing gives a real-time read on rate expectations that can move alongside official Fed signals ahead of the September meeting.
whatToWatch: U.S. jobs and inflation data before the September Fed meeting
Further shifts in Kalshi contract pricing
questions: How much weight should investors give prediction-market odds versus fed funds futures?
